content: नन्दः [नन्द्-भावे घञ्] .²1 Happiness, pleasure, joy. .²2 A kind of lute (11 inches long). (<ls>MW.</ls> 7 inches). .²3 A frog. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a cowherd, husband of Yaśodā and foster-father of Kṛṣṇa (to whose care the child was committed when Kaṃsa wanted to destroy it). .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the founder of the Nanda dynasty; or of nine brother-kings of Pāṭaliputra killed by the machinations of Chāṇakya, the minister of Chandragupta; समुत्खाता नन्दा नव हृदयरोगा इव भुवः <ls>Mu. 1. 13</ls>; अगृहीते राक्षसे किमुत्खातं नन्दवंशस्य <ls>Mu. 1. 27</ls>, <ls n="Mu.">3. 28</ls>. .²7 One of the nine treasures of Kubera. .²8 Number ‘nine’ (from the nine Nandas.). .{@-दी@} An epithet of Durgā.
